_comment: Human-authored gold answer for the synthetic Art. 28 GDPR data processing agreement. Clause types follow Art. 28(3) lit. a to h, plus Chapter V transfers and governing law. The severities encode where the synthetic draft departs from Art. 28(3): unrestricted sub-processing (lit. d), indefinite retention after termination (lit. g), and excluded inspections (lit. h) are the material defects; a transfer clause with no Chapter V mechanism is the fourth.
